manual_review

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
re-apply last known-good snapshot
Proxmox has no SDN rollback of its own

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHY this exists:
PUT /cluster/sdn applies ALL pending SDN config cluster-wide.
Two concurrent tenant applies would each publish the other's
half-written configuration. This is the one place in the system
where per-tenant isolation is impossible and a global lock is the fix.
